caption: The drawing features a single metallic cup positioned in the center of a plain, light-colored background. The cup is rendered in shades of silver and gray, with subtle highlights and shadows that give it a reflective, three-dimensional appearance. The cylindrical cup has a slightly flared rim at the top and a small, slightly raised base. Attached to the right side of the cup is an ornate metal handle with two elegant, outward-facing scrolls, one at the top and one at the bottom. The handle is also colored in shades of silver, consistent with the rest of the cup. Below and to the right of the cup, there is a faint inscription of the name "ROSE CAMPBELL GIERKE" in small, capital letters. The background remains empty except for the cup and the inscription, highlighting the main object without any additional elements or scenery.
title: Silver Beaker with Handles
